games.csv.used_for: Hosts, dates, nations, athletes (women and men), sports and events at every Games

sources.title: Factsheet: The Games of the Olympiad
Factsheet: The programme of the Games of the Olympiad

games.csv.notes: Melbourne 1956 athletes and events include Stockholm; nations are Melbourne only. The continent column is added by this project.

medals_all_time.csv.used_for: All-time Summer medal table, top 30 teams, up to Paris 2024
medals_all_time.csv.notes: Includes medal changes up to 11 August 2024. Teams are not combined with predecessors or successors. The IOC does not publish an all-time table.

sports_programme.csv.used_for: Which sports were at which Games

sources.title: Factsheet: The programme of the Games of the Olympiad

sports_programme.csv.notes: Art competitions and demonstration events are left out. Paris 2024 and the 1956 equestrian events in Stockholm are added from the IOC.

sport_events.csv.used_for: Medal events per sport and the nation with the most medals in each, 1896 to 2020
sport_events.csv.notes: Counted by data/build_sports.py. The total is within 2% of the IOC's for the same Games, but individual Games and sports can differ.
